title: How Many Consensus All-Americans Has Oklahoma Produced?
question: How many consensus All-Americans has Oklahoma football had?
answer: Through the 2025 season, Oklahoma has produced 83 consensus All-Americans, sixth-most among FBS programs, out of 169 first-team All-Americans overall. Linebacker Danny Stutsman (2024) is the most recent.
summary: Oklahoma has 83 consensus All-Americans, sixth in FBS, plus 169 first-team picks and 35 unanimous. See the firsts, two-time honorees and latest Sooner.
body: Oklahoma's All-America tradition runs deep. Through the 2025 season, the Sooners have 169 first-team All-Americans, 83 of them consensus picks, which ranks sixth among FBS programs. Thirty-five of those selections were unanimous, a total the program lists as the most in college football history.

The list starts with fullback Claude Reeds in 1913, the earliest Sooner on OU's All-America roll. End Waddy Young became the program's first consensus All-American in 1938. From there, the postwar boom took over: when Stutsman was honored in 2024, Oklahoma's 81 consensus picks since 1950 led the nation, and its 31 since 2000 were tied with Ohio State for second, behind only Alabama.

A long line of Sooners earned consensus honors more than once, including Jim Weatherall, Greg Pruitt, Tom Brahaney, Rod Shoate, Rick Bryan, Tony Casillas, Rocky Calmus, Tommie Harris, Teddy Lehman, Duke Robinson and Ryan Broyles.

The most recent consensus pick is linebacker Danny Stutsman in 2024, who became OU's 83rd. He was the program's first consensus All-American since receiver CeeDee Lamb in 2019 and its first consensus linebacker since Curtis Lofton in 2007. Stutsman made 109 tackles that year and finished his career with 376, ninth in school history. In 2025, kicker Tate Sandell made several first-team lists but did not reach consensus status.

Consensus status is decided by the NCAA from the major selector teams, which is why a player can be a first-team All-American on one list and still fall short of consensus. For trivia purposes, the number to remember is 83.
